# Paris Advice

> > Comprehensive guide for expats and visitors in Paris, covering family life, cultural activities, and practical resources for English-speaking residents.

Paris Advice serves both expatriates living in Paris and tourists visiting the city, with emphasis on family-friendly activities, English-language services, and cultural institutions like Centre Pompidou, American Church in Paris, and American Library in Paris. The site provides practical information for navigating Parisian life while maintaining connections to English-speaking communities.

## Key Topics

- Expat living in Paris
- Family-friendly activities
- American Church in Paris
- American Library in Paris
- Centre Pompidou
- After-school programs
- English-language services
- Children's extracurricular activities
- Paris attractions and tourism
- Food and wine culture
- Sports clubs (PUC, Stade Charlety)
- Music and arts education
- Expat resources (WICE, FUSAC, AngloInfo)
- French Open (Roland Garros)

## Essential Guides

- [Living in Paris](https://www.parisadvice.com/living-in-paris.html): Essential expat resources including American Church & Library in Paris
- [Visiting Paris - What to See and What to Skip](https://www.parisadvice.com/visiting-paris.html): Essential travel guide for first-time visitors to Paris attractions

## Family Life & Children's Activities

- [After School Activities for Children Living in Paris](https://www.parisadvice.com/after-school-activities.html): Guide to children's extracurricular activities at Centre Pompidou & more
- [Riding the Big Wheel in Paris](https://www.parisadvice.com/big-wheel.html): Family guide to Place de la Concorde ferris wheel with city views

## Food, Culture & Events

- [Find Food and Wine Events in Paris](https://www.parisadvice.com/Food-and-Wine.html): Paris dining guide featuring restaurants, markets, and food events
- [Roland Garros Museum and Tours](https://www.parisadvice.com/Roland-Garros.html): Guide to French Open stadium tours and tennis museum visits
